integrationDecision: Approved to integrate cumulative commits12e035c1 +1cbf08db +db4014c5 as a normal UI call-reduction fix, subject to integration CI. Both Important findings are resolved. This does not establish mobile performance or release acceptance.
positiveChecks: Only 3 production Lua files and 2 focused Lua test files changed (mobile_render_write_cache.lua and mobile_map_size_ownership.lua).
Intent caches are per install and weak-keyed by actual native object; image source and unwrapped image id participate. No actor id/native UID is used as a cache identity.

Size and image caches are populated after setter returns non-false. Throwing setter skips cache assignment; text cache assignment occurs after property write. Production picture adapter now propagates SetImage false.
Expired controls force original setter/property paths rather than suppressing alive guards. Dynamic surface manager generation/retirement logic is unchanged.

Repository-wide search found intent base text/image writes confined to battle_render_actors; intent particle images are separate pooled effect child controls. Base icon tint, alpha, geometry, visibility and particle update/paint paths remain active.
Map color writes, reachable oscillation, scale lerp, rotation, position and scroll paths remain unchanged. Important finding concerns owner reuse, not suppression of those update calculations.

resolvedFindings.title: Cache lives on logical room fx while native controls are reused across room owners
resolvedFindings.detail: roomSize records fx.paintedIcon/paintedRing keyed by control and size. roomFx survives observeMap map identity changes; visible boxes are assigned by current.nodes index. A native box can be written by a different room fx while an earlier fx retains its last-success cache. Returning to the earlier map lets that earlier fx skip the setter even though the actual native dimensions were overwritten.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Use real F.control(require abyss_map_controls), Map.generate(Data,42), UI.new; ui:update(.1); assign ui.map=Map.generate(Data,1); ui:render(); assign original42 map; ui:render(); compare each visible icon.size[1] with fx.size*Layout.sts.iconPerScale*UI.drawScale(fx).
resolvedFindings.observed: return 1 stale room size actual=39.086323079841 expected=40.705995192803
resolvedFindings.baselineEvidence: Same real map sequence passed with only abyss_map_ui loaded from base2d bytes and all other source/build inputs unchanged.
resolvedFindings.suggestedFix: Store last-success size in a view-owned weak table keyed by actual native control, shared across all room fx in that view; or explicitly invalidate all affected fx identities on every control ownership/map transition. Keep failure/expired-control retry and animation updates. Add real map42 -> seed1 -> map42 regression.

resolvedFindings.title: Failed image replacement preserves an invalid previous-success promise
resolvedFindings.detail: intentImages still holds A when trying B. If SetImage changes actual state then returns false, requesting A next skips native write based on old A cache, leaving actual B. Same stale-promise pattern can affect intentTexts when a property write mutates then throws.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Real F/GameUI cultist fixture; old buff image102020; wrap native SetImage to call original then return false once; change Theme.icon.intent.buff to123456789/update; restore102020/update.
resolvedFindings.suggestedFix: Clear intentImages[control] immediately before attempted SetImage; populate after non-false success. Clear intentTexts[value] immediately before property assignment; populate after successful completion. Add A -> failed partially applied B -> A recovery regressions.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Both image and text caches are invalidated before native writes, re-established only after success. Real image and independent text RED probes now PASS; false/throw partial mutation recovery tests PASS.
